description: Since the passing of the Immigration Act of 1965, immigrant workers have had fewer paths of entry, including green card status, into the United States. Unfortunately, this has resulted in a pattern of either unlawful entry, or more commonly, unlawful overstay of temporary visa status, for large numbers of immigrants referred to as "undocumented immigrants."…
